metadata.description: The phased-dev development method: skills and templates for concept-to-release projects built with Claude Code.

plugins.name: phased-dev
plugins.description: A phased development method for agent-built software, from the owner's concept notes through spec and plan to implementation in three project modes (prototype, harnessing, production): one commit per task, independent verification, push per phase, question and feature registers, progress reporting, pause and resume.
